text.tspan: The maternal mortality ratio in 1985 and 2020
Maternal mortality ratio is the estimated number of women who die from maternal conditions per 100,000 live
Estimated maternal mortality ratio in 2020 (deaths per 100,000 live births; plotted on a logarithmic axis)
Estimated maternal mortality ratio in 1985 (deaths per 100,000 live births; plotted on a logarithmic axis)
Data source: WHO, UNICEF, UNFPA, World Bank Group and UNDESA (2025)
